queries.text: The original cites the film by its Brazilian title, "Um Príncipe em Minha Vida"; rendered with its English title, "The Prince & Me" (2004, dir. Martha Coolidge), whose prince is Danish, matching the next segment.

"Não existem mendigos encantados mas apenas príncipes" plays on "príncipe encantado" (Prince Charming); rendered "no Beggar Charmings, only princes" to keep the wordplay. Alternative: "There are no enchanted beggars, only princes."
